spec.name: Reversal v38
spec.notes: High turnover by design: the reversal edge is measured net of 10 bps per unit of turnover.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 3.1, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 3%.

exhibits: The strategy was tested only twice, which is insufficient to establish statistical significance for a high-turnover reversal strategy.

verdict.opinion: The strategy claims a high Sharpe ratio of 3.1, but this is based on only two trials. Given the high-turnover nature of the reversal signal, the performance is highly sensitive to transaction cost assumptions. While the 10 bps cost estimate is included, the lack of rigorous out-of-sample testing or parameter sensitivity analysis makes it premature to deploy real capital. The strategy requires further validation through paper trading to ensure the signal persists under live market conditions and that the turnover-to-cost ratio remains viable.
